camel_example: aliyun hbase RelateDbForHBaseHa --region cn-hangzhou --ClusterId 'bds-t4nj9v2x85000000' --HaStandby 'hb-bp1bl7iqzka000000' --IsStandbyStandard true --HaActiveDBType hbase --HaActive 'hb-bp1w6krp539000000' --HaMigrateType CLUSTER --HaStandbyDBType hbase --IsActiveStandard true
description_en: Adds an active-active instance pair to a BDS cluster
description_zh: 调用此接口在BDS集群中增加添加主备双活实例
kebab_example: aliyun hbase relate-db-for-hbase-ha --cluster-id bds-t4nj9v2x85000000 --ha-active hb-bp1w6krp539000000 --ha-standby hb-bp1bl7iqzka000000 --ha-active-db-type hbase --ha-standby-db-type hbase --is-active-standard true --is-standby-standard true --ha-migrate-type CLUSTER --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RelateDbForHBaseHa

parameters.help_en: The ID of the BDS cluster. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144595.html operation to obtain the cluster ID
parameters.help_zh: BDS集群ID，可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144595.html接口获取
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The tables to synchronize. This parameter is required when HaMigrateType is set to TABLE. Separate multiple tables with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: HaMigrateType为TABLE级别时该项为必填，多个表用半角逗号（,）隔开
parameters.name: ha_tables

parameters.help_en: The HDFS URI of the primary instance. This parameter is required when the primary instance is a non-standard instance (IsActiveStandard is set to false)
parameters.help_zh: 主实例的hdfs链接地址。主实例为非标准实例（即IsActiveStandard为false）时，参数必填
parameters.name: ha_active_hdfs_uri

parameters.help_en: The HDFS directory of the primary instance. This parameter is required when the primary instance is a non-standard instance (IsActiveStandard is set to false)
parameters.help_zh: 主实例hdfs的目录。主实例为非标准实例（即IsActiveStandard为false）时，参数必填
parameters.name: ha_active_hbase_fs_dir

parameters.help_en: The ZooKeeper address of the primary instance. This parameter is required when the primary instance is a non-standard instance (IsActiveStandard is set to false)
parameters.help_zh: 主实例zk地址。主实例为非标准实例（即IsActiveStandard为false）时，参数必填
parameters.name: ha_active_cluster_key

parameters.help_en:
The database engine version of the primary instance. This parameter is required when the primary instance is a non-standard instance (IsActiveStandard is set to false). Valid values:
HBase1x: HBase 1.x.
HBase2x: HBase 2.x.
HBaseUE: HBaseue
parameters.help_zh:
主实例数据库版本。主实例为非标准实例（即IsActiveStandard为false）时，参数必填。
HBase1x：hbase1.x版本。
HBase2x：hbase2.x版本。
HBaseUE：hbaseue版本
parameters.name: ha_active_version

parameters.help_en: The username of the primary instance. This parameter is required when the primary instance is HBaseue
parameters.help_zh: 主实例用户名。主实例为HBaseue时必填
parameters.name: ha_active_user

parameters.help_en: The password that corresponds to the username of the primary instance. This parameter is required when the primary instance is HBaseue
parameters.help_zh: 主实例用户名对应的密码。主实例为HBaseue时必填
parameters.name: ha_active_password

parameters.help_en: The HDFS URI of the secondary instance. This parameter is required when the secondary instance is a non-standard instance (IsStandbyStandard is set to false)
parameters.help_zh: 备实例的hdfs链接地址。备实例为非标准实例（即IsStandbyStandard为false）时，参数必填
parameters.name: ha_standby_hdfs_uri

parameters.help_en: The HDFS directory of the secondary instance. This parameter is required when the secondary instance is a non-standard instance (IsStandbyStandard is set to false)
parameters.help_zh: 备实例hdfs的目录。备实例为非标准实例（即IsStandbyStandard为false）时，参数必填
parameters.name: ha_standby_hbase_fs_dir

parameters.help_en: The ZooKeeper address of the secondary instance. This parameter is required when the secondary instance is a non-standard instance (IsStandbyStandard is set to false)
parameters.help_zh: 备实例zk地址。备实例为非标准实例（即IsStandbyStandard为false）时，参数必填
parameters.name: ha_standby_cluster_key

parameters.help_en:
The database engine version of the secondary instance. This parameter is required when the secondary instance is a non-standard instance (IsStandbyStandard is set to false). Valid values:
HBase1x: HBase 1.x.
HBase2x: HBase 2.x.
HBaseUE: HBaseue
parameters.help_zh:
备实例数据库版本。备实例为非标准实例（即IsStandbyStandard为false）时，参数必填。
HBase1x ：hbase1.x版本。
HBase2x：hbase2.x版本。
HBaseUE ：hbaseue版本
parameters.name: ha_standby_version

parameters.help_en: The username of the secondary instance. This parameter is required when the secondary instance is hbaseue
parameters.help_zh: 备实例用户名。备实例为hbaseue时必填
parameters.name: ha_standby_user

parameters.help_en: The password that corresponds to the username of the secondary instance. This parameter is required when the secondary instance is hbaseue
parameters.help_zh: 备实例用户名对应的密码。备实例为hbaseue时必填
parameters.name: ha_standby_password

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the primary instance
parameters.help_zh: 主实例ID
parameters.name: ha_active

parameters.help_en: The ID of the secondary instance cluster
parameters.help_zh: 备实例集群ID
parameters.name: ha_standby

parameters.help_en: The cluster type of the primary instance. Valid values: HBase and HBaseue
parameters.help_zh: 主实例集群类型，目前支持HBase和HBaseue
parameters.name: ha_active_db_type

parameters.help_en: The cluster type of the secondary instance. Valid values: HBase and HBaseue
parameters.help_zh: 备实例集群类型。目前支持HBase和HBaseue
parameters.name: ha_standby_db_type

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the primary instance is a standard instance. Set this parameter to true for a standard instance
parameters.help_zh: 主实例是否为标准实例，标准实例为true
parameters.name: is_active_standard

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the secondary instance is a standard instance. Set this parameter to true for a standard instance
parameters.help_zh: 备实例是否为标准实例，标准实例为true
parameters.name: is_standby_standard

parameters.help_en:
The synchronization type. Valid values:
CLUSTER: instance-level synchronization.
TABLE: table-level synchronization.
SKIP: no synchronization required
parameters.help_zh:
同步类型。
CLUSTER：实例级别。
TABLE： 表级别。
SKIP：无需同步
parameters.name: ha_migrate_type
